context: A teacher walks a uni student through a public-affairs paper
purpose: Teach: 交通省/官邸/直線/遠隔/無関心/団地/下降/上流

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、交通省と官邸の意思決定プロセスを扱うんですね。
lines.en: So your paper examines the decision-making process between the Ministry of Land and the Cabinet Office.
lines.style: Warm, genuinely interested. Leans forward slightly. No rush. Settling into the conversation with quiet attention on his work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。地方団地の住民が無関心になりがちな話、改めて検証します。
lines.en: Yes. I'm re-examining how residents in these local complexes tend to disengage—looking at it fresh.
lines.style: Thoughtful, a little tentative. Building the idea as he speaks. Genuine but uncertain of how much he's thought it through. Slight breath before the dash.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 直線道路の整備計画、上流側と下流側、両面から見ると深まります。
lines.en: The infrastructure plans—when you look at them from both perspectives, upstream and downstream, it becomes much richer.
lines.style: Encouraging without being prescriptive. Light, almost conversational. Each clause flows into the next with a sense of discovery, like she's thinking alongside him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 遠隔地への影響、データで補強します。
lines.en: I'll strengthen the remote-area impact section with data.
lines.style: Decisive, slightly faster. He's heard and is already moving forward. Clipped but not curt—the rhythm of someone making an internal note.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 住民の参加意欲が下降してる地域、要因分析が要ですね。
lines.en: In areas where resident participation is dropping, you'll really need solid factor analysis.
lines.style: Gentle insistence. Not a warning, more a steady hand pointing to where the work matters most. Slight emphasis on 'really'—not forceful, just real.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Quiet and complete. A nod in his voice. Not dismissive—the sound of someone who's heard and will carry it forward.
